PlayerProfile.title: PlayerProfile
PlayerProfile.description: Authenticated player profile, cumulative candy clean-up stats, stage progression, and gameplay preferences.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

displayName.description: Player arcade display name (1 to 40 characters).

bestScore.description: Highest single-run score achieved across all modes.

totalCandiesCleared.description: Cumulative count of candies cleared across all runs.

bestCombo.description: Highest cascading combo multiplier achieved in a single turn.

hapticsEnabled.description: Whether tactile haptic feedback is enabled during swipes and matches.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when profile was last updated.

ScoreRecord.title: ScoreRecord
ScoreRecord.description: Immutable record of a completed Candy Sweep game run for personal high-score history.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase Auth UID of the score owner.

mode.description: Game mode played: CLEANUP (frosting stage) or SCORE_RUSH (25-move blitz).

score.description: Final score achieved during the run.

candiesCleared.description: Number of candies cleared in the run.

maxCombo.description: Highest combo chain reached during the run.

movesUsed.description: Total moves used during the run.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when the run was recorded.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when the run was recorded.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user player profile, cumulative candy clean-up statistics, unlocked stage progression, and settings.

/users/{userId}/scores/{scoreId}.description: User-scoped high-score history subcollection storing completed game runs.
